title: Out-of-band transfer: the structured/uri response

source.note: composed: §6.4 — "a message with MessageType field set to 'control' containing a submessage with the format field set of 'structured' and subformat of a URI". The URI is composed.

message.content: Upload large content to the end-point in the submessage.

expect.text: Upload large content to the end-point in the submessage.
expect.canonical_json: {"messagetype":"control","format":"text","subformat":"english","content":"Upload large content to the end-point in the submessage.","submessages":[{"format":"structured","subformat":"uri","content":"https://agent.example.com/nlip/upload/9f2"}]}

notes: "subformat of a URI" is ambiguous: it can be read as the Table 1 subformat value `uri`, or as the subformat field *holding* the URI. This case takes the first reading, which is the only one Table 1 supports and the only one that leaves a place for the URI itself (the content). The second reading would produce a structured-subformat warning for every such response.
